facts.fact: Legal 500 (Ibrachy & Dermarkar) says Law No. 151 of 2020 has its Executive Regulations in force with a grace period running to 1 November 2026.
facts.system: Egypt Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020

facts.fact: Legal 500 (Ibrachy & Dermarkar) says the Executive Regulations under the Law were issued in November 2025.
Legal 500 (Ibrachy & Dermarkar) describes the Personal Data Protection Center as operating the licensing regime, with licensing portals and DPO accreditation.
